tui.update.checking.note: First line of /update. 'Running sessions' are the user's agent runtimes, separate processes the update never stops; the reassurance is the point of the line. Lower-case start, terminal voice.

tui.update.updating.note: Shown while the installer runs. {version} is a version number like 0.98.1, keep verbatim. 'Running sessions' are the user's agent runtimes, which keep working.

tui.update.restarting.note: After a successful install, just before the terminal relaunches. Only the terminal viewer restarts; agent sessions run in their own processes and keep running. {version} verbatim.

tui.update.relaunch_when_idle.note: After a successful install when local in-terminal work prevents the relaunch. 'Local work' is work running inside this terminal (a shell command, an in-process session); 'sessions' are the detached agent runtimes, which keep running. {version} verbatim.
